metadata.label: Pub Note
metadata.value: Group of eleven British War Office Intelligence Division maps of the Transvaal and Orange Free State, issued during the opening period of the Anglo-Boer War, 1899-1900. The 1:250,000 series originally comprised 28 sheets, compiled from existing maps, local surveys, reconnaissance sketches, military reports, and travelers accounts. The compilation provided roads, river crossings, watering places, settlements, and generalized relief at a time when systematic large-scale mapping was incomplete. The eleven maps here are housed in separate cloth covers, each bearing its own pasted title and scale information, allowing the maps to be joined without obscuring the cartography. A composite image combines all eleven sheets. The supplied dealer description notes that the maps were available during the British advance toward Pretoria in 1900, although contemporary commentators criticized their positional accuracy.
